cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll unlock the storeroom if you cover my reception break. That's door access, please note, not a key loan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone spilled coffee in the lobby. Just tell me where the mop is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Behind the buckets. Information is five minutes of cover; opening the door is another ten. Please keep the two items separate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lend me the key. I'll mop first, then cover your break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A key loan includes tomorrow's break. Add that to your offer, please. The fifteen minutes only gets the door opened.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 five plus ten totals fifteen in A5; key custody adds tomorrow break rather than silently changing the existing price.

relationship.evidence: B2 urgent cleaning information and B4 key loan with delayed cover are plausible attempts to get work done.

heightening.evidence: B4 key request causes A5 additional future break condition.
